# Test fixtures

- `screw.step`, `linkrods.step` — sample models shipped with OCCT
  (`data/step/` in the OCCT distribution), LGPL-2.1 + Open CASCADE Exception.
- `as1-oc-214.stp` — the classic AS1 assembly (AP214, with colors and
  assembly structure) from the [STEPcode](https://github.com/stepcode/stepcode)
  test data (`data/ap214e3/`), BSD-licensed.

These files are used only for testing and are not part of the published API.
